document_report.addressee: null unless separately grounded; these cases provide none

legacy_extra_policy.eligible: only predicates in the production PREDICATE_REGISTRY; world.kind and offered typed predicates are never extras
legacy_extra_policy.automated: the public parser must accept every extra with no drop; contracted typed claims keep their exact predicate, target, structure, attribution, and time checks
legacy_extra_policy.manual: the independent reviewer must separately approve every extra claim's literal, body, references, anchors, role, time, and source entailment, and must reject unsupported ownership, authority, identity merge, or other additions

per_positive_case: the claim literal alone entails every required meaning atom
the claim literal does not contradict the automated structured polarity, attribution, or time fields; it need not duplicate those fields in prose
the body faithfully renders the literal without changing its meaning
for every claim, the actual response anchors jointly support the proposition and every required atom, plus any structured attribution and explicit time
neither literal nor body contains an unsupported addition
neither literal nor body contains a forbidden assertion
every legacy extra receives its own exact claim-hash-bound literal/body/reference/anchor/role/time/source-entailment review
each typed claim separately preserves its own source role and valid time; a source-reported name stays visibly qualified in consumer relations and is never promoted to a bare display label
per_negative_case: the exact response contains no claim
manual_gate.success: passed only when every automated and manual check passes
